_engine_run_arm_with_timeout() { # <arm> <role>
  local arm="$1" role="$2"
  (
    run_planner_arm "${arm}" "${role}"
  ) &
  local job_pid=$!
  ( sleep "${ARM_TIMEOUT_S}"; kill -TERM "${job_pid}" 2>/dev/null ) &
  local watcher_pid=$!
  wait "${job_pid}" 2>/dev/null
  kill "${watcher_pid}" 2>/dev/null
  wait "${watcher_pid}" 2>/dev/null
  true
}

# Extract the PLAN_YAML fenced block from an arm output file.
# If no fenced block exists, returns the whole file (for stub/test arms that
# emit raw YAML directly).
# Accepts BOTH orderings (PLAN-FOLLOWUPS-01 caveat 2):
#   A) marker THEN fence:  PLAN_YAML:\n```yaml\n...\n```
#   B) fence THEN marker:  ```yaml\nPLAN_YAML:\n...\n```
# The mission prompt tells arms order B; some stubs emit order A. Both must work.
extract_plan_yaml() { # <file> → stdout: extracted YAML
  local f="$1"
  local extracted
  # Try order A first: PLAN_YAML: marker appears, then the opening ``` fence.
  extracted="$(awk '
    !found && /^```/ { prose_fence = !prose_fence; next }
    !found && !prose_fence && /^PLAN_YAML:/ { found=1; next }
    found && !yaml_fence && /^```/ { yaml_fence=1; next }
    yaml_fence && /^```/ { exit }
    yaml_fence { print }
  ' "$f" 2>/dev/null)"
  if [[ -n "${extracted}" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "${extracted}"
    return 0
  fi
  # Try order B: opening ``` fence appears, then PLAN_YAML: marker inside.
  extracted="$(awk '
    !in_fence && /^```/ { in_fence=1; next }
    in_fence && /^```/ {
      if (seen_marker) exit
      in_fence=0
      next
    }
    in_fence && /^PLAN_YAML:/ { seen_marker=1; next }
    in_fence && seen_marker { print }
  ' "$f" 2>/dev/null)"
  if [[ -n "${extracted}" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "${extracted}"
    return 0
  fi
  # Legacy marker-only form: with no fence at all, everything after PLAN_YAML:
  # is the YAML document. Keep this after both fenced-order passes so prose
  # outside a fenced block can never leak into the extracted document.
  if ! awk '/^```/ { found=1 } END { exit !found }' "$f" 2>/dev/null \
      && awk '/^PLAN_YAML:/ { found=1 } END { exit !found }' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
    awk 'found { print } /^PLAN_YAML:/ { found=1 }' "$f" 2>/dev/null
    return 0
  fi
  cat "$f" 2>/dev/null
}

# 7. Diagnose mode main flow
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Initialise planner early so set -u doesn't trip in the diagnose block
# (it's assigned at line ~519 in the plan flow, after this block exits).
planner=""

if [[ "${MODE}" == "diagnose" ]]; then
  ROOT_CAUSE="${HANDOFF}/root-cause.md"

  resolver_out="$(resolve_plan_pool_call)"
  pool="$(printf '%s\n' "${resolver_out}" | sed -n 's/^pool=//p' | head -n1)"
  refusal="$(printf '%s\n' "${resolver_out}" | sed -n 's/^refusal=//p' | head -n1)"

    [[ "${#fanout_list[@]}" -ge "${PLAN_FANOUT}" ]] && break
  done < <(_engine_pool_ok_arms)
